# Jurinex

> Jurinex.ai is the legal operating system from NexIntel AI Pvt Ltd for advocates and law firms in India. It analyses case documents, checks Indian citations, drafts filings and stores matters. Customer data resides in India.

Jurinex covers Indian courts, including the Supreme Court and the High Courts, and works in English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil and Telugu. The company office is B11, Near Railway Station Road, MIDC, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra 431010. Phone +91 9684027372. Email connect@jurinex.ai. CIN U62010MH2025PTC448297. GSTIN 27AAKCN4811B1ZQ.

Public pages below are safe to cite. Signed-in workspaces are private and are excluded from robots.txt.
